name: Embodiment-first recovery family
question: Before spending more controller or RL budget, which inherited quadruped embodiment provides full authored home support and at least two collision-free foot contact opportunities from every frozen resting orientation?

candidates.hypothesis: The rigid twelve-actuator body already has enough leg workspace for a controller to establish a two-foot recovery brace in every resting orientation.
candidates.falsifiedIf: The authored home has fewer than four feet within tolerance, or any frozen resting orientation has fewer than two collision-free foot contact opportunities.

candidates.hypothesis: Split-torso waist articulation removes the rigid body's directional recovery-contact bottleneck without compromising nominal support.
candidates.falsifiedIf: The authored home has fewer than four feet within tolerance, or waist articulation still leaves any frozen resting orientation below two collision-free foot contact opportunities.

candidates.hypothesis: Extended hip travel on the rigid torso creates a collision-free two-foot brace in every recovery direction.
candidates.falsifiedIf: The authored home has fewer than four feet within tolerance, or the extended rigid workspace still needs self-collision to reach two feet in any frozen resting orientation.

candidates.hypothesis: The contact-seeking waist plus expanded lateral workspace supplies a two-foot brace from every required resting orientation while preserving four-foot nominal support.
candidates.falsifiedIf: The authored home has fewer than four feet within tolerance, or any frozen resting orientation remains below two collision-free foot contact opportunities.
